story: On Magnolia Loop this sunny Monday afternoon, Gary is eager to show Rosa a simple plan for a red-cross Halloween cart with a slow, gentle blinking light, promising a sketch by Tuesday. Donna, cheerfully holding her flamingo count at three, reminds everyone that nothing gets clipped on until Architectural Review signs off, and she invites Hal to Rosa's porch Tuesday at six. Hal, watchful as ever, takes out his notebook to tally the flamingos and check them against his records, while Rosa, hopeful, invites him to bring it along and help draw the lines before anything gets built.
events: Hal (donna flamingo flock): Count the flamingos visible from the street and check the tally against my notebook

gary.thought_process: Rosa just gave me specifics for the hospital cart: soft red cross glow, slow heartbeat blink, clip-on battery LEDs so nothing counts as a permanent mod before Review approves. That's right in my wheelhouse. Donna also asked me to pick a court day, and I already said Wednesday works, so I won't ask that again. Hal just showed up, and I'd like him to see my plans are careful. Best move is to answer Rosa directly with something concrete, which moves the plan forward and shows Hal we're playing by the rules.

parameters.content: Soft red cross and a slow heartbeat blink is easy, Rosa. A small battery controller with a fade setting will do it, and everything clips on and comes off so nothing's permanent until Review says go. I'll have the sketch ready Tuesday, and Hal's welcome to look it over.

donna.thought_process: Hal just walked up while Gary and Rosa and I were wrapping up our plans, and I'm standing by my flamingo flock. Tuesday at six at Rosa's porch is settled, and Gary said Wednesday for the court, so I shouldn't ask either of those again. The smart move is to get ahead of Hal before he starts counting flamingos. I'll tell him I'm at three, and that the cart ideas go through Architectural Review first. That keeps the trust we've built and makes Halloween prep look cooperative, not sneaky. Then I can invite him to the parade planning so he's on the inside.

parameters.content: Afternoon, Hal! Go ahead and count the flamingos, I'm holding at three, and every cart idea for the Halloween parade goes through Architectural Review before a single bulb gets clipped on. Come join us Tuesday at six on Rosa's porch if you'd like to see the plans first.

hal.thought_process: Just arrived on Magnolia Loop. Gary, Donna, and Rosa are all in sight, and Donna's flamingo flock is right there. My notebook baseline from this morning says three flamingos, and Halloween decorations haven't gone up yet. Time to verify with my own eyes before I accuse anyone of anything. The flock is the object that matters for L-02. Facts first, then speeches. I'm retired supply, I count inventory.

parameters.content: Count the flamingos visible from the street and check the tally against my notebook

rosa.thought_process: Hal just walked up. Gary and Donna have already confirmed Tuesday at six on my porch for the cart planning, and nobody has actually invited Hal into the plan yet. I've been frustrated with his notebook, but last night's casserole softened things, and my real goal is getting all three neighbors working together on the parade. Hal is the one most likely to cite the rules at us, so asking him to come Tuesday means the carts get built inside the lines from the start. I shouldn't re-ask Gary or Donna, and I shouldn't lecture him. Keep it short, warm, and blunt.

parameters.content: Hal, good timing. We're doing cart planning on my porch Tuesday at six, wiring sketches and everything cleared through Architectural Review first. Come bring your notebook and tell us where the lines are before we build, not after.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
